basic_details.job_title: TMC Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre, H.R.D. Department, has invited online applications for one Project Technical Support-III post in the ICMR-funded "TeNET Study: Terbium-161 DOTATATE in Metastatic Neuroendocrine Tumors: Assessment of Safety and Efficacy" (Project A/c. No.110210), initially for six months. Pay is Rs. 36,400 p.m. including 30% HRA. The essential qualification is M.Sc in Life Science / M. Pharm with Post graduate Diploma in Clinical research, or M.Sc. in Clinical Research, or Pharm D. Apply online at tmc.gov.in by 05:30 p.m. (IST) on 30.11.2026.

how_to_apply: Apply through the "Online Application" only, using the link given in the notice: https://tmc.gov.in/Temp/frm_Registration.aspx.
Submit the application before 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time) on 30.11.2026.
Fill the experience column as "Fresher" if you have no experience.
Give a valid email ID, because all correspondence is by email only.
Internal candidates must submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator.
Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Tata Memorial Centre does not take responsibility for non-receipt of applications online.
important_instructions: If any candidate is found at any stage not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If any shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith. Outstation candidates will not be provided accommodation. Information about the interview date will be sent by email to eligible candidates only. Receiving, downloading and printing the related documents is the candidate's responsibility. Tata Memorial Centre is not responsible for emails lost due to a wrong email ID or delivery to a spam or bulk folder. Enquiries: contact No. 24177000 Extn. 4664 or email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: TMC Project Technical Support-III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the place of posting.

rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre, Tata Memorial Hospital, H.R.D. Department (Grant-In-Aid Institute of Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India)
TeNET Study: Terbium-161 DOTATATE in Metastatic Neuroendocrine Tumors: Assessment of Safety and Efficacy (Project A/c. No.110210)
Initially for a period of six months

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is under the TeNET Study, which examines Terbium-161 DOTATATE in metastatic neuroendocrine tumors, assessing its safety and efficacy. The project is funded by ICMR. The notice is issued by the H.R.D. Department of Tata Memorial Hospital, part of Tata Memorial Centre, a grant-in-aid institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The notice is signed HRD (PROJECT), TMH.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post with one vacancy. Candidates should appear only if all the required course certificates are completed and available. The notice prints the age limit as "Age Limit- 25-Years" and gives no cut-off date or relaxation. Candidates with no experience must write "Fresher" in the experience column of the form. The official notification should be checked for any further eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc in Life Science / M. Pharm with Post graduate Diploma in Clinical research; OR M.Sc. in Clinical Research; OR Pharm D
rows.desirable: At least one year of clinical research experience (preference will be given to experienced candidates)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration is Rs. 36,400/- p.m., which includes 30% HRA, so HRA is not paid on top of this amount. The engagement is initially for a period of six months. Candidates may be offered a lower grade than advertised, based on working experience, research track record and overall assessment at the time of interview and the recommendation of the Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Apply through the "Online Application" only, using the link given in the notice: https://tmc.gov.in/Temp/frm_Registration.aspx . Submit the application before 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time) on 30.11.2026. Fill the experience column as "Fresher" if you have no experience. Give a valid email ID, because all correspondence is by email only. Internal candidates must submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Tata Memorial Centre does not take responsibility for non-receipt of applications online.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are initially screened, and called for interview, on the basis of the information in the online application form. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit, based on qualifications and experience. Merely meeting the prescribed qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called. It also reserves the right not to call any candidate without assigning a reason. If there are more candidates, a Written Exam/MCQ Test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice; it will be sent by email to eligible candidates only. Candidates called for interview must carry: the online application form; a resume; original documents with one set of copies supporting date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste/disability certificate etc. Applicants who fail to bring these will not be allowed to appear for interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If any candidate is found at any stage not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If any shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith. Outstation candidates will not be provided accommodation. Information about the interview date will be sent by email to eligible candidates only. Receiving, downloading and printing the related documents is the candidate's responsibility. Tata Memorial Centre is not responsible for emails lost due to a wrong email ID or delivery to a spam or bulk folder. Enquiries: contact No. 24177000 Extn. 4664 or email [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TMC Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Project Technical Support-III under the ICMR-funded TeNET Study.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of online application is 30.11.2026, up to 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The qualification is M.Sc in Life Science / M. Pharm with Post graduate Diploma in Clinical research, or M.Sc. in Clinical Research, or Pharm D. At least one year of clinical research experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice prints the age limit as 25 years. It gives no relaxation and no cut-off date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 36,400/- p.m. including 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply only through the online application at https://tmc.gov.in/Temp/frm_Registration.aspx before the last date. Applications by any other mode are not accepted, as the notice asks for "Online Application" only.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are screened from the online form and called for interview. If there are more candidates, a Written Exam/MCQ Test is held to shortlist them for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: The post is a project post, initially for a period of six months under the TeNET Study funded by ICMR.

faq.question: Q9. What should candidates called for interview bring?
faq.answer: They must carry the online application form, resume and original documents with one set of copies, covering date of birth, qualifications, experience and caste/disability certificate etc. Internal candidates also need an NOC from their HOD/Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q10. Will accommodation be provided for outstation candidates?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.
